title: Freeze Core2 flash/cache handoff at exact virtual times and reject unbound PC symbols

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13.15, QEMU 9.2.2 virtual Core2

checks.name: exact_time_pause
checks.detail: SIGSTOP at requested virtual time preserved both vCPU states and controller registers.

checks.name: early_window_classification
checks.detail: The 14.800033 second freeze had no fixed PC cluster.

checks.name: late_window_classification
checks.detail: The 15.301447 second freeze reached a Flash block/cache-handshake source-pattern candidate, but no matching ELF/MAP exists.

checks.name: bin_elf_mapping
checks.detail: All three CPU0 sampled VMAs mismatch between the public BIN and local UIFlow2 v2.5.3 ELF.

checks.name: uart_storm
checks.detail: The exact-time freeze and BIN byte audit do not support the prior UART ISR mapping.

checks.name: guest_deadlock
checks.detail: A cache restore, SSI or DPORT operation remaining unreturned is still a candidate, not a proven deadlock.

checks.name: legacy_application_frame
checks.detail: The same public firmware remained banner-only and reset without a non-empty application frame.

notes: The freeze closes the high-frequency-sampling ambiguity but does not close RUNTIME-03.
Source-pattern names are not ELF-bound symbols.
The full UIFlow2 peripheral matrix was not rerun after 0038.
All functional results are virtual-device validation.
The retained dirty QEMU tree must not be reset or cleaned.
